title: Pure Trade manufactures a metal case for the new Diesel women's fragrance
summary: Designed by Bureau Tonalli for L'Oréal, this oval tinplate case holds the bottle of Only Desire, the new diesel women's fragrance together with a scented body product. According to Pure Trade, from an industrial point of view, everything rests on the fully rounded contours and on the embossed graphics of the lid, which push the drawing of the metal to its limits in an exact balance between mechanical strength and formability.
